Name: Start
Description: Specifies the starting color of the gradient, mapped to the darkest (black) areas of the input map.

Name: End
Description: Specifies the ending color of the gradient, mapped to the brightest (white) areas of the input map.

Name: Hue
Description: Adjusts the hue of the gradient colors, allowing for global color shifts across the entire gradient.

Name: Saturation
Description: Controls the intensity or vividness of the gradient colors. Higher values produce more vibrant colors, while lower values result in muted tones.

Name: Lightness
Description: Sets the overall brightness of the gradient colors, making the output lighter or darker.

Name: Processing
Description: Applies additional enhancement to the gradient's tonal range or contrast before tinting.

Name: Enhance
Description: Applies additional enhancement to the gradient's tonal range or contrast before tinting.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No enhancement is applied; the gradient is mapped directly from the input.

Flubs.Name: Autolevel
Flubs.Description: Automatically adjusts the levels to maximize the full tonal range, improving contrast in the gradient mapping.

Flubs.Name: Equalize
Flubs.Description: Equalizes the histogram, distributing intensity values more evenly for a balanced gradient effect.

Name: Reverse
Description: Inverts the gradient mapping, swapping the start and end colors so that black maps to the end color and white maps to the start color.
